abstract: This package is the canonical standalone source for MartiX.Platform guidance. It routes current-versus-target Platform decisions, Generated Solution topology, modular-monolith and vertical-slice design, typed contracts, persistence, reliable events, security, quality gates, migrations, and exact AOT/performance claims.
